title: IndexManifest
description: The index page's manifest of every report in an output directory: window.__LSD_INDEX__ in index.html. Each report's data loads from its <stem>-report.js when opened. Stable from 1.0.0: a minor version only adds, and a breaking change takes a new major version. Objects accept properties they do not list. Optional fields follow the report's rule: never written empty, and missing reads as empty.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the schema the manifest follows; the same as the reports'. 1.0.0 for this schema.

title.description: A heading for the index. Optional: lsd-mono-jvm does not write it, and the page shows `LSD reports` when it is absent.

generatedAt.description: When the index was written: an RFC 3339 date-time, with Z or a UTC offset.

usagePing.description: As for a report: a missing value, or missing options, is read as false.

reports.description: Failed reports first, then warnings, aborted, passes and skipped; by title within each. Absent when there are none.

messageCount.description: How many message events the scenario has.

id.description: The report's file-name stem, unique in the directory; its page's file name for an entry that is only a link.

href.description: The report's own page (<stem>-diagram.html). Used when there is no data script.

data.description: <stem>-report.js. Absent for an entry that is only a link.

scenarios.description: In report order, so the index lists them before the data loads. Absent when the report has none.
